title: ReportNarrative
description:
Prose the model produced, in which every factual sentence carries its support. A claim with no citation is not a weaker claim to be shown with a caveat -- it is dropped, because a sentence a reader cannot check is indistinguishable from one that is invented.

The model states no score, band, severity or count. Those come from the deterministic engine, and there is nowhere in this document to put one.

kind.description: Measured restates what evidence shows. Inferred draws a conclusion from it and may be wrong. Recommended proposes an action. The interface shows these differently, because a reader who cannot tell a measurement from an inference will treat both as fact.

support.description: At least one immutable evidence identifier or approved knowledge-base reference. Enforced here as well as in code, so an unsupported claim cannot even be serialized.
